name: Olsson Family Engineering Scholarship
summary: Up to $10,000 for second or third-year Griffith engineering students facing educational disadvantage.
key: Maximum value is $10,000, paid in two instalments.
who: Full-time in your second or third year of the Bachelor of Engineering at Griffith.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Apply by Monday 22 March 2027, 4pm, for Trimester 1 2027.
Can't be received in more than one year.
